application_credentials.description:
Fuelio Routes reads your trips from Google Drive with your own Google Cloud OAuth client. Follow the [instructions]({more_info_url}) to create one:

1. On the [OAuth consent screen]({oauth_consent_url}) add your Google account as a test user (or publish the app).
1. Enable the **Google Drive API** for the project.
1. On the [Credentials]({oauth_creds_url}) page create an **OAuth client ID** of type **Web application**.
1. Add `{redirect_url}` to *Authorized redirect URIs*.

Then enter the client ID and secret here.
